summary_en: Shinki Bus raised its FY2027 year-end dividend forecast by 5 yen to 30 yen per share, bringing the full-year dividend to 50 yen, while continuing strategic investments in priority business areas and vehicle/equipment upgrades.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Shinki Bus announced on November 9, 2026, that it had revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company raised its year-end dividend prediction from 25 yen per share to 30 yen per share, an increase of 5 yen. This brings the full-year dividend to 50 yen per share, compared to the previous forecast of 45 yen per share.

The revision reflects the company's basic policy of balancing strategic investments in priority business areas with expenditures for vehicle and equipment upgrades to enhance safety and environmental performance, while increasing shareholder returns. The company made this decision based on a comprehensive assessment of consolidated business performance trends. The company notes that it conducted a 2-for-1 stock split effective October 1, 2025, and the stated dividend amounts reflect post-split figures.
